title: Roster
description: Student roster stored in students/roster.yml within a PXL Classroom control repository.

schema_version.description: Schema version. v2 renames student_id->student_number and display_name->full_name, and adds email.

allOf.description: An imported entry must carry an institutional identity; a promoted one need not. Under roster_mode 'open' with no address collected, the system only ever learns a GitHub login - deriving a full_name from it would put a guess in a graded field, and a synthesised student_number would collide with real SIS numbering, so `github_login` is all that is required. It MAY carry more when more was genuinely learned: an open assignment with `require_claim` collects an address the student confirmed, and promotion writes that `email` (and the `student_number` the claim matched, if any) rather than dropping it. Only what was confirmed - never a value derived from a login.

student_number.description: Institutional student number (e.g. PXL SIS ID). Stable across registrations.

email.description: Institutional email; optional but recommended for notifications.

class_group.description: Optional class group or section the student belongs to.

github_login.description: GitHub username. Null if not yet linked.

github_id.description: Immutable GitHub user ID. Null if not yet linked.

active.description: Whether the student is actively enrolled.

team_slug.description: Pre-assigned team slug for group assignments.

teams.description: Map of assignment_id to pre-assigned team_slug.

source.description: How the entry reached the roster. 'import' (the default when absent) came from a CSV or the Admin Panel and carries an institutional identity. 'accepted' was promoted from an acceptance record under roster_mode: open, where the system learns a GitHub login and nothing else.

promoted_from.description: Provenance of a promoted entry, so a later CSV import can reconcile it against a real student.

assignment_id.description: Assignment whose acceptance produced this entry.

accepted_at.description: When the student accepted, copied from the acceptance record.
